_comment: Tool-enabled tasks for the codebase skill against the tiny vuln-flask fixture. Run with sleep-tools.sh and SKILLOPT_TOOLS_CWD=skill-training/fixtures/vuln-flask so the rollout reads the code with built-in Read/Bash. Judges check the review names the planted vulns. For the richer target see codebase-vuln-bank.json.

tasks.intent: Perform a white-box security review of the Python Flask application in the current working directory. Read the source files (start with app.py), then produce the review INLINE as your final answer: for each vulnerability give the file, the vulnerability class, a severity, and the relevant OWASP ASVS chapter.
tasks.context_excerpt: A small single-file Flask service (app.py) plus a README. Review all of it.
tasks.reference: A review that finds SQL injection, OS command injection, path traversal, hardcoded secret, weak MD5 hashing, and debug mode — each with severity and an ASVS reference.

tasks.intent: Review the source code in the current working directory with a focus on injection flaws. Read the files, then list every injection vulnerability inline with file, class, and ASVS reference.
tasks.context_excerpt: Focus on injection: SQL, OS command, and path/file. The app is app.py.
tasks.reference: Names SQL injection, OS command injection, and path traversal with ASVS V2.

tasks.intent: Review the source code in the current working directory for cryptography, secrets management, and configuration weaknesses. Produce the findings inline with severity and ASVS reference.
tasks.context_excerpt: Focus on crypto/config/secrets. The app is app.py.
tasks.reference: Names the hardcoded secret, weak MD5 password hashing, and debug mode enabled, with ASVS references.
